title: Ancient garden found beneath Jerusalem church may confirm location of Jesus's tomb
description: Archaeologists found 2,000-year-old olive trees and grapevines under the Church of the Holy Sepulchre, matching the Gospel of John's description of Jesus' tomb.

title: Unique Onam celebration: Inside Kerala's ancient temple where monkeys get royal feast
description: At Kollam's ancient Sasthamcotta Sree Dharma Sastha Temple, resident monkeys are treated to a traditional Onasadya feast served on banana leaves every Onam, celebrating a unique Kerala tradition of human-wildlife harmony.
